facts.text: The resort is in the highlands north of Ubud in Payangan, Gianyar, surrounded by tropical forests with views of Bali's seven peaks.
facts.excerpt: Buahan is located in the lush highlands north of Ubud in Payangan, Gianyar, surrounded by tropical forests and views of Bali's seven peaks.

facts.text: Buahan is an adults-only retreat.
facts.excerpt: Tucked within the lush highlands north of Ubud, this adults-only retreat invites you to rediscover the beauty of doing less.

facts.text: The resort is guided by a 'No Walls, No Doors' philosophy of open-air living spaces and uninterrupted views.
facts.excerpt: "No Walls, No Doors" is Banyan Tree Escape design philosophy, inviting guests to experience a deeper connection with nature through open-air living spaces, uninterrupted views, and a seamless relationship with the surrounding environment.

facts.text: Each private bale is an interpretation of a traditional Balinese pavilion, positioned to frame a distinct view of the surrounding landscape.
facts.excerpt: Each private 'bale', our interpretation of a traditional Balinese pavilion, is thoughtfully positioned to frame a distinct view of Buahan's surrounding landscape

facts.text: Each bale has a private pool, open-air living spaces and uninterrupted views of the surrounding landscape.
facts.excerpt: has been thoughtfully designed with a private pool, open-air living spaces, and uninterrupted views of the surrounding landscape.

facts.text: Each bale was built using locally sourced and reclaimed materials, including Ulin wood.
facts.excerpt: each _bale_ has been constructed using locally sourced and reclaimed materials, including resilient Ulin wood given new life within the resort.

facts.text: The Above the Waterfall Pool Bale sits above a cascading waterfall, surrounded by rainforest.
facts.excerpt: Hidden above a cascading waterfall and embraced by lush rainforest, this is Buahan's most secluded bale.

facts.text: The Seven Peaks Pool Bale has panoramic views of Bali's seven peaks emerging with the morning light.
facts.excerpt: Wake to Buahan's most iconic moments as Bali's seven peaks emerge with the morning light. Framed by panoramic mountain views and open-air living

facts.text: The Buahan Valley Pool Bale overlooks forested hills, rice terraces and the river, and has a heated private pool.
facts.excerpt: Our signature bale overlooks Buahan valley, where forested hills, rice terraces, and river create an ever-changing natural panorama. Complete with a heated private pool

facts.text: Each bale is designed for a maximum of two adults.
facts.excerpt: Each _bale_ is designed for a maximum of two adults. Extra beds and additional guests cannot be accommodated.

facts.text: Every stay includes daily breakfast and a daily five-course dinner at Open Kitchen for two guests.
facts.excerpt:
- Daily **breakfast** at Open Kitchen for two guests
- Daily five-course **dinner** at Open Kitchen for two guests

facts.text: Every stay includes 24-hour access to a dedicated Escape Host.
facts.excerpt: 24-hour access to your dedicated **Escape Host**

facts.text: Complimentary use of resort mountain bikes is included in every stay.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary use of resort **mountain bikes**

facts.text: Open Kitchen is the signature restaurant, celebrating locally sourced ingredients, seasonal harvests and Indonesian culinary traditions.
facts.excerpt: Open Kitchen is Buahan's signature restaurant, celebrating locally sourced ingredients, seasonal harvests, and the richness of Indonesian culinary traditions.

facts.text: The Botanist Bar serves handcrafted cocktails, locally roasted coffee and botanical refreshments.
facts.excerpt: The Botanist Bar is a destination for handcrafted cocktails, locally roasted coffee, and botanical refreshments inspired by Indonesia's rich natural larder.

facts.text: Jungle Affair is a candlelit multi-course dinner in a private pavilion in the rainforest.
facts.excerpt: Set within a private pavilion surrounded by nature, enjoy a candlelit multi-course dinner inspired by Indonesian flavours

facts.text: Toja Spa is an open-air spa named after the Indonesian word for water.
facts.excerpt: Toja Spa, meaning "water" in Indonesian, is an open-air spa concept that enhances your connection with nature.

facts.text: Toja Spa is exclusively available to in-house guests.
facts.excerpt: Toja Spa is exclusively available for in-house guests

facts.text: Sejoli is a couples' treatment with a heart-centred meditation, a Balinese massage and a herbal flower bath.
facts.excerpt: Sejoli is our signature couples' wellbeing journey, featuring a heart-centred meditation, Balinese massage, and a fragrant herbal flower bath

facts.text: Many daily wellbeing experiences, including yoga and meditation sessions, are complimentary for in-house guests.
facts.excerpt: Many of Buahan's daily wellbeing experiences, including yoga and meditation sessions, are complimentary for in-house guests.

facts.text: The outdoor swimming pool has panoramic views of the jungle and nearby mountains.
facts.excerpt: Offering panoramic views of the jungle and nearby mountains, the pool provides a serene space to relax and immerse yourself in nature

facts.text: The Bamboo Pavilion is used for yoga sessions and can be transformed for romantic dinners.
facts.excerpt: It serves as a serene venue for yoga sessions and can be transformed for romantic dinners

facts.text: The Soul Freedom Journey is a guided purification ritual at the resort's waterfall, beginning with making a Canang Sari offering.
facts.excerpt: Connect with Bali's spiritual traditions through a guided purification ritual at Buahan's waterfall. Beginning with the creation of a Canang Sari offering

facts.text: The Sandikala Walk goes through the rice fields at twilight with a local farmer, covering the Subak irrigation system and watching the fireflies.
facts.excerpt: walk through the rice fields at twilight with a local farmer, learn about the Subak irrigation system and rice traditions, watch the fireflies

facts.text: Jungle Cooking at Dukuh Asri lets guests fish, forage and cook with locals over an open flame, followed by a farm-to-table jungle lunch.
facts.excerpt: Visit Dukuh Asri to fish, forage, and cook with locals over an open flame, then enjoy a farm-to-table jungle lunch.

facts.text: The resort's natural rainforest setting has sloping terrain, pathways and stairs connecting different areas.
facts.excerpt: is situated within a natural rainforest setting characterised by sloping terrain, pathways, and stairs that connect different areas of the resort.

facts.text: Guests in the open-air bales can expect changing weather, natural sounds and occasional encounters with local wildlife and insects.
facts.excerpt: Guests can expect changing weather conditions, natural sounds, and occasional encounters with local wildlife and insects that are part of the surrounding environment.

facts.text: The dry season from April to October is ideal for outdoor activities and clear mountain views; the green season runs from November to March.
facts.excerpt: The dry season from April to October is ideal for outdoor activities and clear mountain views, while the green season from November to March brings lush landscapes

facts.text: Bales have no walls, just curtains for privacy and roll-down bamboo shades for rain.
facts.excerpt: They have no walls, just breezy curtains for privacy and roll-down bamboo shades in case of rain.

facts.text: Bathrooms have hand-hammered copper bathtubs and carved wooden mirrors made by Balinese carpenters.
facts.excerpt: Bathrooms come with double sinks, hand-hammered copper bathtubs, and ornate wooden mirrors (each one unique) carved by Balinese carpenters.

facts.text: Toja Spa is spread over open-air bamboo pavilions overlooking the Ayung River.
facts.excerpt: It's spread out over a clutch of open-air bamboo pavilions which overlook the Ayung River

facts.text: Drive time to central Ubud is given as about 30, 40 or 45 minutes.
facts.excerpt: Buahan, a Banyan Tree Escape is located approximately 40 minutes north of central Ubud

facts.text: The dining venues are open-air and overlook the rainforest and river valley.
facts.excerpt: our open-air dining venues overlook Bali's lush rainforest and river valley, offering a peaceful dining experience immersed in nature.

contradictions.note: p1 says about 40 minutes from central Ubud, p3 says about 30 minutes, p7 says 45 minutes

sources.excerpt: approximately 40 minutes north of central Ubud
approximately 30 minutes north of central Ubud

contradictions.note: p1 says about 90 km from the airport, p7 says 48 km

sources.excerpt: approximately 90 kilometres from Ngurah Rai International Airport (DPS)
